schedule._comment_tiploc_station: TIPLOC of the crossing's OWN station (Portslade, CRS PLD — verified against CORPUS; note it is PSLDAWH, not PORTSLD). Used only to read whether a CIF schedule CALLS here (arrival/departure present) or merely passes, so a passenger service beyond the ~2h LDB window is classified correctly instead of defaulting to non-stopping.

openLagSecs._comment: Anchored to TD clear-step time, NOT bestTime. Derived from 24 Jun 2026 observer session cross-checked against FOI (auto-raise on FM/AC track-circuit clear). passenger east n=4 (obs 36-43s, 45 adopted with safety margin); passenger west n=6 (obs 15-23s); freight east n=2; freight west n=0 DELIBERATE GUESS.

closeTrigger._comment: CLOSE start anchored to the approach.from strike (0006 E / 0003 W). CALIBRATION: east stopping 100s = 24 Jun observer clean-approach cluster (80-113s, n=5). PROVISIONAL/uncalibrated: east freight 100s (n=0), east other/non-stopping 80s (n=0), west other 20s (n=0). west stopping = departure-45s is ACCURACY-tuned (central, not safe: ~half of n=8 tip late by <=~30s; departures were minute-rounded). predictedLeadSecs.east 180 = pre-strike east prediction leads the crossing (measured barrier-down ~2-3.5min), replaces closeBefore.east for display. safetyNetSecs (east 210, west 90) = conservative CLOSED backstop from LIVE bestTime for a MISSED strike, set smaller than the strike's typical lead (east 0006 ~280s, west 0003 ~120s) so the precise strike normally wins; east 210 sits inside the measured 129-257s band, west 90 is the safe-side value. All backstops PROVISIONAL (thin/rounded data).
